figmaCorrections.issue: The token table maps 'Text/Hint' to #374151, but the rendered handoff consistently uses #6b7280 for all hint/placeholder text (search placeholder, column-head text, inactive pagination, 'Showing'/'items' labels). The variable definition and its rendered usage disagree.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Reconcile the 'Text/Hint' variable to a single value (#6b7280 appears to be the intended hint color) so handoff consumers don't have to guess which value is authoritative.

figmaCorrections.issue: Column header uses #6b7280 at 16px on #f9fafb. While 16px/600 is large enough to pass AA UI/large-text (3:1), #6b7280 on #f9fafb is borderline for the smaller 13px 'Showing'/'of N items' labels which reuse the same hint color.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Verify #6b7280 hint text meets WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1) at the 13px body-3 sizes; darken toward #4b5563 for the smallest hint labels if it fails.

figmaCorrections.issue: Masthead line 1 is rendered #1f2937 while line 2 uses #374151 (Text/Dark); two near-identical dark grays are used in adjacent masthead lines with no semantic distinction.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Standardize both masthead lines on a single Text token (#374151) unless the #1f2937 difference is intentional and tokenized.
